programme.desc: Successful, happily-married Devin, stumbles upon "damsel in distress", Skyler, on his way to work one day. When Devin decides to stop and help her, he ends up getting more than he bargained for. He realizes much too late that she has him wrapped in her deceitful web of temptation. programme.title: The Warrior's Way
programme.desc: Refusing to kill an infant from an enemy clan, master swordsman Yang (Jang Dong-gun) takes the child and flees to an American frontier town. He puts away his sword for good, vowing to raise the baby in peace. Yang befriends Lynne, a woman who wants revenge against a colonel, the man who murdered her family. When the colonel returns to wreak havoc on the town, Yang draws his sword to protect his new friends, but the sound of fighting draws Yang's murderous clansmen into the fray as well.

programme.title: Red Headed Stranger
programme.desc: The Rev. Shay (Willie Nelson) moves out West to set up his new home in Montana so that he can spread God's word. But when his wife, Raysha (Morgan Fairchild), leaves him for another man -- in part because she wants to return to Philadelphia -- the reverend decides to replace his spiritual ways with a gun. After shooting down his wife and her lover, he battles a landowner intent on keeping all of the town's water for himself. But his deadly ways make him yearn for a belief in God again.

programme.title: Jane Got a Gun
programme.desc: Panic strikes Jane Hammond (Natalie Portman) when her outlaw husband John returns to their farm with bullet wounds. Expecting the worst, she brings her young daughter to safety and travels to the home of Dan Frost (Joel Edgerton), a boozing ex-lover who may be her only hope. With Dan now on her side, Jane prepares for a showdown with the vengeful John Bishop and his gang of thugs. Looking to settle an old score, Bishop must now contend with the gun-toting Jane and her new partner.

programme.title: Dreamscape
programme.desc: Selfish teen Alex Gardner (Dennis Quaid) is coerced into joining a government project in which psychics like him are trained to enter others' dreams. He starts learning to use his abilities to do good, but before long, a new official, Bob Blair (Christopher Plummer), seizes control of the project. A writer (George Wendt) helps Alex uncover Blair's true motives, which involve assassination via dreams. Soon, only Alex and a beautiful scientist (Kate Capshaw) stand in the way of something terrible.

programme.title: Limitless
programme.desc: Facing unemployment and his girlfriend's rejection, writer Eddie Morra is sure that he has no future. That all changes when an old friend gives him a drug that produces enhanced mental acuity. Stoked on the untested chemical, Eddie rises to the top of the financial world and attracts the attention of a tycoon (Robert De Niro) who intends to use him to make a fortune. But terrible side-effects and a dwindling supply threaten to collapse Eddie's house of cards.

programme.title: Space Truckers
programme.desc: A freight pilot (Dennis Hopper), his girlfriend (Debi Mazar) and an apprentice (Stephen Dorff) try to deliver cargo to Earth in 2197.

programme.title: The Blob
programme.desc: A drive-in favorite, this sci-fi classic follows teenagers Steve (Steven McQueen) and his best girl, Jane (Aneta Corseaut), as they try to protect their hometown from a gelatinous alien life form that engulfs everything it touches. The first to discover the substance and live to tell about it, Steve and Jane witness the blob destroying an elderly man and grow to a terrifying size. But no one else has seen the goo, and policeman Dave (Earl Rowe) refuses to believe the kids without proof.

programme.title: Communion
programme.desc: A novelist's (Christopher Walken) wife (Lindsay Crouse) and son (Joel Carlson) see him changed by an apparent encounter with aliens in the mountains.

programme.title: The Lawnmower Man
programme.desc: The eccentric Dr. Lawrence Angelo puts mentally disabled landscaper Jobe Smith on a regimen of experimental pills and computer-simulated training sequences in hopes of augmenting the man's intelligence. In time, Jobe becomes noticeably brighter and also begins to fare much better with the opposite sex. As he develops psychic powers, he realizes that those around him have taken advantage of his simplicity his whole life, and he plots a bloody revenge.

Dev takes the law in his own hands and teaches a lesson not only to her attacker but also to those who similarly victimised other girls in the past. But his actions do not sit well with the police and the revenge-hungry politician.

programme.desc: The TAPS team investigates the home of Dr. Samuel Mudd, an alleged conspirator to the assassination of Abraham Lincoln. programme.desc: TAPS has received an urgent call for help from a Chicago community center whose patrons are being chased away by a variety of menacing spirits. programme.desc: This week TAPS heads to Thousand Island, NY to investigate a 4-acre private island and is joined by the " King of Rock and Roll" himself, Meatloaf. The immediate family of six resides in the boathouse while the mansion serves as guest quarters for visitors. The property has been in the family for fifty years and has always had a haunted history.

The USS Salem was the first American ship to arrive on the scene and provided relief supplies and assistance.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS heads to Chicago Illinois to investigate a Chicago landmark for nearly a century, the Congress Theater. Built in 1926, the massive building's original Italian Renaissance architecture remains mostly preserved. The Congress has transitioned through the decades of Chicago history and exists today as a renowned live concert venue. According to many present and past employees, there is also something undeniably paranormal present at the theater.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: The TAPS team has been called to wrangle some ghosts that seem to be haunting the resting place of Buffalo Bill. The museum staff has asked the TAPS team to help them figure out if the old cowboy has made this site his final rest stop. Cody died in Denver in 1917 and his final request was to be buried on Lookout Mountain with views of the mountains and plains where he spent most of his life.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS heads to the Florida Panhandle to investigate a notoriously haunted lighthouse with over a century's worth of paranormal reports. Located on the Pensacola Naval Air Station, home of the Blue Angels, the Lighthouse stands 160 feet above Pensacola Bay and the Florida Gulf Coast. The beacon ranges in diameter from 30 feet at the base to 15 feet at the top and is total of 177 steps.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS is called to the former home of one of the world's most famous authors in order to investigate a series of startling paranormal occurrences. Mark Twain and his family occupied this architecturally unique house for nearly 20 years. After his daughter died in the home, Twain and his family abandoned the property. Today, the curators of the house are plagued with an array of strange sights and sounds.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: This week, TAPS takes a call from the American Legion in Pennsylvania where people are terrified by paranormals. The building was established in the 1700s and was once rented out as apartments. The current owners have had the property since 1974 and are convinced that the place is haunted, so TAPS heads in to find out. Jason and Grant begin the hunt on the third floor where the current owner says she's too afraid to go.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: In the exciting season finale, TAPS travels to the site where Hindenburg, one of history's most infamous disasters, took place. The Hindenburg was a German airship filled with hydrogen for buoyancy. In 1937, while trying to dock at the Lakehurst Naval base, it caught fire and killed 36 people. The entire ordeal was caught on film and is still one of the most famous tragedies that have ever been reported.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: Fort Ticonderoga, located in upstate New York, is being haunted by the dead from three nations and needs help from the TAPS team. The fort was built in 1755 by the French army, and would be witness to several bloody battles over the next two decades. The British army suffered 2,000 casualties; it was the most devastating battle on American soil until the Civil War. Due largely to the amount of violence and death that took place, there is lots of paranormal activity reported.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, the TAPS team has been asked to go to Paddy Reilly's Bar in Manhattan, New York to help explain some after hours activity. Dark shadows have been seen in the basement, voices have been heard, glasses are known to move on their own, and bottles break for no apparent reason. In an upstairs apartment, three men saw an apparition riding a bike, and across the hall a tenant saw a man resembling Gene Hackman peering through a window.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, the TAPS team visits the Absecon Lighthouse in Atlantic City, NJ. This lighthouse has activity reported ranging from untraceable footsteps and doors opening spontaneously, to coughing coming from the keeper's quarters. In the lighthouse itself, people have reported smelling cigar smoke, hearing voices and laughter, and even seeing a persons hand.Jason and Grant start out in the tower, where they hear a possible conversation and footsteps.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters the TAPS team investigates Preston Castle, a once notorious reform school for boys in Northern California. People have seen apparitions of a man in a white coat in the doctor's office. The infirmary seems to be haunted by a boy that was shot while trying to escape the school. Upstairs there are claims of humming noises, groups of voices, a mist and a woman who claims she was pinched on the butt.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS has been called to the Grzelak house in Massachusetts where they have been experiencing paranormal activity since the day they moved in 30 years ago. programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS is called to Cape Cod to investigate the Orleans Inn. Some of the claims here are that candles light on their own, glasses slide off tables, hauntings by two separate men who hung themselves, doors opening and closing, and ghosts of naked women. Despite all this, the strangest claim comes from Room 5, where two separate guests have checked in and been driven to insanity inside the room.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS becomes the first paranormal team to be invited to investigate Norwich State Hospital, in Norwich, Connecticut. There have been lots of rumors of activity, including moving shadows, haunting faces, screams, moans, and apparitions of children. Excited to start investigating, Jason and Grant start out in the research building and right away they see a moving shadow followed by a strange noise, and faint light in the stairway.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS drives to the Otesaga Resort Hotel in Cooperstown, NY. Employees are terrified by voices calling out to them and doors swinging all on their own. Guests in the hotel also hear non-existent children running the halls and furniture being dragged across the floor upstairs (even on the top floor), while shadows and orbs have been seen and moaning has been heard. Jason and Grant start out in the ballroom, and try to debunk the claim of an orb.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS has been asked to help the 1875 Inn in Tilton, New Hampshire. The Inn has had two major fires, one of which supposedly took the life of a child named Laura, who now haunts the hotel. One claim is that about 30 people saw a gargoyle-like creature suspended in the air. Another claim is hair being stroked, and there are numerous "Laura" encounters.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS visits the location of the "shot heard round the world" at the Colonial Inn in Concord, Massachusetts. The history goes all the way back to 1775, when wounded soldiers from the Battle of Concord were brought to the site for medical attention.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters

There are reported feelings of uneasiness in 'the office,' which is where William Lemp committed suicide. The bar area was once the bedroom of Charles Lemp, who killed his dog and then himself it's said that people see him walking around with his dog at his side.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters

programme.title: Ghost Hunters

programme.title: Ghost Hunters

programme.title: Ghost Hunters

programme.title: Encrypt
programme.desc: In a post-apocalyptic wasteland, the fate of the world lies in the hands of a former Army officer (Grant Show).

programme.title: Virtuality
programme.desc: Virtual-reality technology endangers 12 astronauts as they embark on a 10-year mission in outer space.

programme.title: Deathlands: Homeward Bound
programme.desc: Based on the works of James Axler. Humans struggle to survive in a world ravaged by war and radiation.

programme.title: Terminal Invasion
programme.desc: Police are transporting convicted killer Jack (Bruce Campbell) to a prison when their car crashes into a tree due to a raging snow storm. They are forced to bring Jack to an airport, where pilot Cathy Garrett (Chase Masterson) is refusing to fly until weather conditions calm down. Due to the efforts of a mysterious preacher, it isn't long before Jack and the passengers realize that there are extraterrestrials in their midst. But there is only one way to find out who is human.

programme.title: Saint Sinner
programme.desc: A monk (Greg Serano) from the 19th century travels into the future to stop the two female demons he unwittingly released.

programme.title: Painkiller Jane
programme.desc: A woman (Emmanuelle Vaugier) develops amazing powers after exposure to a biochemical weapon alters her genetic makeup.

programme.title: Encrypt
programme.desc: In a post-apocalyptic wasteland, the fate of the world lies in the hands of a former Army officer (Grant Show).

programme.title: Iceman
programme.desc: On an Arctic expedition, Stanley Shephard (Timothy Hutton) discovers Charlie (John Lone), a Neanderthal man frozen in ice. With a team of scientists, Shephard revives Charlie and learns that he has been cryogenically suspended for 40,000 years. Stanley grows close to Charlie as he observes the man and learns about his prehistoric culture -- but when the media catches on to the discovery, Stanley must protect Charlie from fellow scientists who want to use his corpse for scientific research.

programme.title: Army of Darkness
programme.desc: 3rd Evil Dead movie. Ash (Bruce Campbell) finds himself trapped in medieval times. He must quest for the Necronomicon, a book of evil which can return him to his time. Unfortunately, he releases the evil trapped inside the book and unleashes an army of the dead.

programme.title: Dawn of the Dead
programme.desc: When her husband is attacked by a zombified neighbor, Ana (Sarah Polley) manages to escape, only to realize her entire Milwaukee neighborhood has been overrun by the walking dead. After being questioned by cautious policeman Kenneth (Ving Rhames), Ana joins him and a small group that gravitates to the local shopping mall as a bastion of safety. Once they convince suspicious security guards that they are not contaminated, the group bands together to fight the undead hordes.

programme.title: Land of the Dead
programme.desc: In a world where zombies form the majority of the population, the remaining humans build a feudal society away from the undead. Ruthless Paul Kaufman (Dennis Hopper) rules and protects this microcosm but enforces painful class distinctions. Second-in-command Cholo DeMora (John Leguizamo) attempts to lead a secret rebellion against Kaufman's tyranny, but when the zombies begin to evolve, the survivors must discover a way to protect themselves from a zombie hoard that can learn and adapt.

programme.title: Werewolf: The Beast Among Us
programme.desc: A mysterious creature terrorizes a village, and Daniel teams up with werewolf hunters to track down the vicious beast. As villagers are attacked one by one and, themselves, turned into beasts, Daniel fears the foe is someone close to them all.

programme.title: The Wolfman
programme.desc: Though absent from his ancestral home of Blackmoor for many years, aristocrat Lawrence Talbot (Anthony Hopkins) returns to find his missing brother at the request of the latter's fiancee, Gwen (Hugo Weaving). He learns that a creature has links to an ancient curse turning people into werewolves when the moon is full. To save the village and protect Gwen, he must slay the bloodthirsty beast, but he contends with a horrifying family legacy.

programme.title: My Little Eye
programme.desc: As part of an Internet reality show, five people sign up to spend six months in a mansion while cameras film constantly. If each person stays the entire length of the show, everyone walks away with $1 million -- a premise that seems too good to be true. Strange things start happening, like the arrival of mysterious, disturbing packages, filled with items like guns and morbid letters. After an unexpected death, the participants start to question the true reality of this experiment.

programme.title: The Skulls II
programme.desc: The Skulls, a secret college society whose influence reaches the highest levels of government and business, recruits Ryan Sommers (Robin Dunne), whose future success now seems all but assured. Then one day he sees one of his fraternity brothers kill a young woman -- a crime that Ryan must keep secret if he is to remain a Skull. While Kelly (Lindy Booth), a good friend, pushes him to follow his conscience, Ryan's girlfriend, Ali (Ashley Lyn Cafagna), surprises him by being against his snitching.

programme.title: The Skulls III
programme.desc: In this sequel, beautiful and determined college student Taylor Brooks (Clare Kramer) is intent on joining the secret society known as the Skulls, despite its history of being an organization consisting solely of men. Although she encounters strong resistance, Taylor takes steps toward being accepted into their ranks, but her efforts are derailed when her boyfriend is found dead. Taylor is considered the prime suspect. Can she clear her name and track down the real murderer?

programme.title: The Skeleton Key
programme.desc: Caroline Ellis (Kate Hudson), a good-natured nurse living in New Orleans, quits her job at a hospice to work for Violet Devereaux (Gena Rowlands), an elderly woman whose husband, Ben (John Hurt), is in poor health following a stroke. When Caroline begins to explore the couple's rundown Bayou mansion, she discovers strange artifacts and learns the house has a mysterious past. As she continues to investigate, she realizes that Violet is keeping a sinister secret about the cause of Ben's illness.

programme.title: The Watcher
programme.desc: The Watcher is an exciting psychological thriller that takes a unique look into the minds of both a serial killer and the man who must, reluctantly, pursue him. In an almost Hitchcockian way, the film quickly introduces us to the killer, David Allen Griffin, played by Keanu Reeves, who for many years, preyed on lonely young women in the Los Angeles area. The story is set up to create a taut cat-and-mouse game between Griffin and FBI agent Joel Campbell.

programme.title: Boogeyman
programme.desc: Mike (Eddie McClintock), the town sheriff, has to battle the mythical Boogeyman after boys accidentally release it.

programme.title: Divergent
programme.desc: Tris Prior (Shailene Woodley) lives in a futuristic world in which society is divided into five factions. As each person enters adulthood, he or she must choose a faction and commit to it for life. Tris chooses Dauntless -- those who pursue bravery above all else. However, her initiation leads to the discovery that she is a Divergent and will never be able to fit into just one faction. Warned that she must conceal her status, Tris uncovers a looming war which threatens everyone she loves.

programme.title: The Divergent Series: Insurgent
programme.desc: Now on the run from Jeanine (Kate Winslet) and the rest of the power-hungry Erudites, Tris (Shailene Woodley) and Four (Theo James) search for allies and answers in the ruins of Chicago. They must find out what Tris' family sacrificed their lives to protect and why the Erudites will do anything to stop them. Side by side, Tris and Four face one seemingly insurmountable challenge after another, as they unravel the secrets of the past and -- ultimately -- the future of their world.

programme.title: The Divergent Series: Allegiant
programme.desc: Tris (Shailene Woodley) escapes with Four (Theo James) to journey beyond the wall that encloses Chicago. For the first time, they leave the only city and family they have ever known to find a peaceful solution. Once outside, they learn shocking new truths that render old discoveries meaningless. As the ruthless battle threatens humanity, Tris and Four quickly decide who to trust to survive. Tris must ultimately make difficult choices about courage, allegiance, sacrifice and love.

programme.desc: Jurors heard about the mental and physical health issues of the defendant. They wanted to play down that mental health woes was a mitigating factor to why and how Nelson committed this heinous crime.

All this started from when Nelson was hit by a car as a little boy followed by numerous head injuries he sustained as a teenager.

programme.title: Nanny Abduction Murder Trial
